title: Bench and Bell(a)
notes: Jack says have a nice workout with your dog

exercises.name: Dumbbell bench press
exercises.description:
1. Sit on the end of a flat bench with a dumbbell on each thigh.
2. Lie back, bringing the dumbbells to chest level with palms facing forward.
3. Bring your shoulders back and down, engage your core, and take a breath.
4. Press the dumbbells straight up until your arms are extended. Exhale at the top.
5. Slowly lower the dumbbells to the sides of your chest over 3 seconds.
6. Keep your wrists stacked over your elbows throughout.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell curl
exercises.instructions: Set the bench to about 45 degrees. Let your arms hang straight down and keep your elbows back.
exercises.description:
1. Set a bench to a 45 degree incline and sit back with a dumbbell in each hand.
2. Let your arms hang fully extended with palms facing forward.
3. Take a breath and curl both dumbbells up without moving your elbows forward. Exhale at the top.
4. Pause briefly and squeeze your biceps.
5. Slowly lower the dumbbells until your arms are fully extended.

exercises.name: Dumbbell skull crushers
exercises.instructions: Keep your elbows steady and pointed at the ceiling. Lower slowly and stop if your shoulders start to take over.
exercises.description:
1. Grab a pair of dumbbells and lie on a flat gym bench.
2. Straighten your arms and position the dumbbells over your chest with your wrists neutral (hands facing one another).
3. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and plant your feet flat on the floor.
4. Take a breath and slowly bend your elbows to bring the dumbbells to the sides of your head.
5. Hold the position momentarily and extend your arms by squeezing your triceps. Exhale near the top.

exercises.name: Band pull aparts
exercises.instructions: Keep your arms straight and pull from your upper back, not your arms. Don't shrug or flare your ribs.
exercises.description:
1. Stand tall holding a resistance band in front of your chest with both hands, palms facing down and arms straight.
2. Bring your shoulders back and down, and engage your core.
3. Take a breath and pull the band apart until your arms are out to your sides in a T. Exhale as you pull.
4. Squeeze your shoulder blades together briefly at the end.
5. Slowly return to the start, keeping tension on the band.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Around the World
exercises.instructions: These are a nice full upper body but u kinda just gotta feel the timing out
exercises.description:
1. Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell by the handle in both hands in front of your hips.
2. Brace your core and keep your chest tall.
3. Pass the kettlebell around your waist, handing it from one hand to the other behind your back and again in front.
4. Keep your elbows close and the kettlebell tight to your body throughout.
5. Breathe steadily, and switch directions halfway through the time.
